name: A Sealed Crate
summary: A trader asks you to bring in sealed crates as bandits and thieves strike the trade routes. Other abandoned crates may need the same care.

sections.title: At the Pile
sections.body: The trader thanks you for your hard work and asks you to set the delivery beside a pile. A payment is ready. Bandits and thieves have lately risen against the trade routes, so other crates left lying around may need to be brought here as well.

faq.q: Why are crates being left around?
faq.answer: Bandits and thieves have been intercepting trade routes, leaving crates lying around.

faq.q: What should I do with other crates?
faq.answer: Bring other crates you find to the trader, who says they will handle the rest.

faq.q: Who is asking for the crate?
faq.answer: A trader asks you to leave the delivery beside a pile and offers payment for your work.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Sealed Crate
